About.title: About Me
About.body: Full-stack developer based in Agadir, Morocco. I build complete web apps with Next.js, TypeScript and PostgreSQL — from a 3D cinematic tribute to a real-time pool leaderboard to a management SaaS. Currently open to freelance, full-time or remote opportunities.

ecommerce.title: Clothing E-Commerce Website
ecommerce.description: Full-stack e-commerce website for clothing, featuring product browsing, cart functionality, user auth, and Stripe checkout.

recipe-app.title: Recipe App
recipe-app.description: A community-driven recipe platform where users can add their own recipes, browse dishes shared by others, and explore a growing collection of cuisines.

surf-camp.title: Surf Camp SaaS
surf-camp.description: Comprehensive management platform for surf camps — bookings, session scheduling, equipment tracking, and instructor management.

poolhomies.title: PoolHomies
poolhomies.description: Real-time pool match tracker for friend groups — live animated leaderboard, streak tracking, head-to-head stats, and instant match logging via Supabase subscriptions.

better-call-saul.title: Better Call Saul!
better-call-saul.description: A cinematic single-page tribute to Saul Goodman — GSAP title-card intro, scroll-choreographed "case files" with stamp slams, a React Three Fiber inflatable Lady Liberty, an SSE live client counter, and a hover-triggered Kim Wexler outro.

task-manager.title: Task Management App
task-manager.description: A productivity tool for managing tasks with add, delete, and toggle complete features. Built with React hooks for state management.

rock-paper-scissors.title: Rock-Paper-Scissors (Python)
rock-paper-scissors.description: Interactive Rock-Paper-Scissors game built in Python with a command-line interface. Includes a scoring system, multiple game modes, and a smart AI.

calculator.title: Calculator App
calculator.description: Full-featured calculator with basic arithmetic operations, clean design, and responsive button layout.

counter.title: Counter Application
counter.description: Interactive counter demonstrating React state management with increment, decrement, and reset functionality.
